deepdive.sec: City Gas Distribution (CGD) EPC & Clean Energy Infrastructure

bull_bear.body: Debt restructuring planned post-H1FY27 to reduce cost from 16-17% to ~9%; No equity raise planned currently; Focus on converting high-cost NBFC loans to structured bank debt; Promoters looking to increase holding.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Working capital strain (negative cash flow despite growth); Execution risk on CBG commissioning; Geopolitical delays in Middle East expansion; Dependency on PSU payments (70% of mix); Margin pressure from competitive bidding in tender-based EPC.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly optimistic and aggressive on growth (70-80% guidance); Transparent about cash flow dynamics (growth-led not stress-led); Disciplined on margin protection (willing to walk away from low-margin work); Confident in transition from unlisted 'tax-saving' mindset to listed 'wealth-creation' ethos.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Management explicitly attributed historical low margins (8% in FY22-23) to unlisted status/tax avoidance, signaling a structural re-rating in profitability now that listed; CBG plant revenue model is direct gas sales to PSUs (4 LOAs secured) rather than just EPC; Working capital cycle disparity (35 days for CGD vs 15 days for Solar) drove vertical diversification.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: CGD EPC: INR 83.24 Cr revenue, ~15.3% PAT margin, 30-35 day working capital cycle, 70% PSU / 30% Private client mix. Power/Solar EPC: INR 35.37 Cr revenue, 9.5-10% margin, 10-15 day working capital cycle. CBG: 2 TPD plant commissioning Q1FY27 (INR 3.5-4 Cr capex), targeting INR 1.4-1.5 Lakh/day revenue at ~22-23% PAT margin.

| Intense competition in solar EPC leading to margin compression; Working capital constraints for smaller EPC players | Unlisted Regional EPC Contractors | loser | High | Desco's listed status allows access to cheaper debt and surety bonds (unlike peers), enabling them to win larger PSU tenders while maintaining margins, squeezing out unlisted competitors. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Fast-growing infrastructure and energy services company (est. 2011) with capabilities across City Gas Distribution (CGD), Power Distribution, Renewable Energy and Water Infrastructure; recognised as a Top 10 Oil & Gas Service Provider (2023) and listed on the BSE SME platform.
- Backed by 34+ years of leadership experience under Chairman & Managing Director Pankaj Pruthu Desai, with PAN India presence across 18+ states and a workforce of 250+.
- Trusted execution partner to leading PSUs and corporates including Adani Gas, Bharat Petroleum, GAIL (India), IndianOil, Reliance Industries, Torrent Power and Gujarat Gas.
- ISO 9001:2015 certified, with proven safety systems and compliance culture, including a safety excellence recognition from Adani Total Gas (2021).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body: - [Corporate structure] Formerly known as Desco Infratech Private Limited; listed on the BSE SME platform in 2025.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Overall margin compression due to entry into lower-margin (9.5-10%) Solar/Power EPC to improve cash conversion cycle. CGD margins remain robust (~15% PAT). Management committed to rejecting low-margin tenders to protect profitability.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: 70-80% YoY for FY27 (conservative); Margins: Sustainable at current levels with structural improvement expected as scale increases; Order Inflow: Pipeline of INR 650 Cr (INR 470-480 Cr CGD, INR 100 Cr Solar/Power); Capex/Commissioning: CBG plant (2 TPD) commissioning Q1FY27; expansion to 15-20 TPD over next 18 months.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Total INR 345 Cr: ~96% CGD (INR 330-332 Cr) with 18-24 month execution timeline; ~4% Power Distribution/Solar with ~12 month timeline. Includes INR 35-40 Cr O&M contracts (24 months).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: CBG expansion to 15-20 TPD (INR 25 Cr capex planned in Gujarat/MP); International entry via Dubai subsidiary (delayed due to Middle East crisis); Untapped CGD market (only 6.5% piped gas penetration vs 93% opportunity).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Desco Infratech delivered ~99% YoY revenue growth to INR 118.8 Cr in FY26, driven by aggressive CGD execution and new solar/power verticals, though margins compressed slightly due to mix shift. The strategic pivot includes a near-term CBG commissioning (Q1FY27) and a disciplined order book selection to sustain ~20% EBITDA margins despite high working capital deployment.
